## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui. Do not edit ~/adaptive-artifacts (the adaptive-artifacts-change-gate constraint applies there). Reuse `scripts/artifact_store.py` (`resolve`, `binary`, `Target.cli_args`) to find the store and binary. Existing tests drive the CLI as a subprocess through `tests/conftest.py` and `tests/helpers.py` fixtures; follow that pattern. The real store at ~/.artifacts/se-workflow is read-only for you. A later task builds a Textual app on this model, so expose plain dataclasses or dicts with no UI code.
